# 10049 "Non-Storable Content" is informational and fires *because* we send
# Cache-Control: no-store on this JSON API (which is what we want — no caching
# of API responses). There is no header that removes it without re-introducing
# the Storable/Cacheable finding, so it is ignored rather than "fixed".
